from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
import json,hashlib
root=Path.cwd();d=root/'reports/research/510300_cftc_treasury_position_source_qualification_v1'
assert not d.exists(),'该有限实验已有记录，不覆盖重跑'
d.mkdir();(d/'sources').mkdir()
proposal_path='reports/research/510300_multidim_treasury_long_supply_cause_score_v1/next_source_question.json'
proposal=json.loads((root/proposal_path).read_text(encoding='utf-8'));assert proposal['proposal_id']=='E7'
protocol={'study_id':'510300_CFTC_TREASURY_POSITION_SOURCE_QUALIFICATION_V1','experiment_id':'E7',
 'registered_at':datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),'phase':'FIXED_SINGLE_YEAR_SOURCE_QUALIFICATION',
 'hypothesis':proposal['hypothesis'],'why_distinct':proposal['why_distinct'],
 'source_catalog':proposal['source_catalog'],'source_description':proposal['source_description'],
 'source_scope':{'year':2023,'report_family':'Traders in Financial Futures Futures Only',
 'market':'原10年美国国债期货，按官方合约名称/代码唯一定位，排除Ultra10及其他美债期限',
 'background_pages_max':3,'annual_archives_max':1,'delay_notice_pages_max':2,
 'attempts_per_url':2,'do_not_retry_403_429':True,'max_concurrent':2,
 'compressed_size_limit_mb':25,'uncompressed_text_limit_mb':100,
 'no_alternative_provider_or_year_in_this_route':True},
 'fixed_fields':proposal['fixed_fields_to_qualify'],
 'source_gate':{'correct_contract_and_tff_futures_only':True,'weekly_coverage_explicit':True,
 'long_short_and_oi_complete':True,'publication_date_or_supported_upper_bound_for_each_observation':True,
 'no_observation_date_backfill':True},
 'clock_rule':'普通周二观察/周五发布只是待核假设；历史延迟必须使用官方声明和可证明上界，不把2023旧日期一律回填为正常周五。时钟仍不可定位则有限路线SOURCE_GATE_NOT_PASSED。',
 'candidate_single_field':'100×(杠杆资金短−长)/总OI；源资格通过后另登记，不在来源阶段计算或选收益。',
 'interpretation_limits':proposal['known_official_boundaries']+['期货类别净空不能说明现金债抛售、基差套利或被迫平仓；不称独立外生冲击。'],
 'stop':'来源不合格就结束有限路线，保留NOT_RUN；不扩年、不换合约、不改回报时段营救。若源通过，则2022—2025覆盖另登记后再考虑同池固定比较。',
 'equity_returns_loaded':False,'new_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'parameter_searches':0,
 'new_repository_code_edits':0,'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,'orders_authorized':False,
 'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','goal_achieved':False}
(d/'protocol.json').write_text(json.dumps(protocol,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
inputs=[proposal_path,'reports/research/510300_multidim_treasury_long_supply_cause_score_v1/result.json']
freeze={'registered_at':protocol['registered_at'],'before_new_annual_values_or_equity_returns':True,
 'protocol_sha256':hashlib.sha256((d/'protocol.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 'input_hashes':{rel:hashlib.sha256((root/rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for rel in inputs},
 'authority_config_snapshots':{rel:json.loads((root/rel).read_text(encoding='utf-8')) for rel in ['config/510300_historical_cause_discovery_v1.json','config/510300_existing_data_training_mandate_v1.json']}}
(d/'freeze.json').write_text(json.dumps(freeze,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print('已登记E7：2023一份TFF期货年档、原10年一合约，只有来源资格核对。')
